question: Who among the following launched the IndiaAI initiatives in 2025?​
solution:
The correct answer is option 4,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The IndiaAI initiative was officially launched by the **Union IT Minister** to strengthen India’s position as a global hub for artificial intelligence.
 
• The initiative aims to promote **AI research, innovation, and adoption** across various sectors such as healthcare, education, agriculture, and governance.
 
• IndiaAI serves as a national program fostering collaboration between **industry, academia, and government** entities to accelerate AI-driven solutions.
 
• The platform has a focus on creating **skilled manpower** through training programs and enhancing AI literacy at grassroots levels.
 
• IndiaAI works under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and aligns with the vision of a digitally empowered India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Artificial Intelligence (AI):**

 
 
• AI refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines programmed to think and learn.
 
• Key applications include natural language processing, machine learning, and robotics.
 
• AI is transforming industries by improving efficiency, decision-making, and innovation.
 
 
 
• **National AI Strategy:**
 
 
• The Government of India has laid out a vision for leveraging AI for social and economic growth.
 
• Focus areas include responsible AI, ethical frameworks, and democratization of AI technologies.
 
• IndiaAI aligns with this strategy to ensure inclusive development.
 
 
 
• **Digital India Program:**
 
 
• Launched in 2015, the Digital India initiative aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society.
 
• It focuses on areas such as digital infrastructure, governance, and digital literacy.
 
• IndiaAI is a major step under this program to enhance technological capabilities.
 
 
 
• **AI in Governance:**
 
 
• AI is being used for policy analysis, decision-making, and service delivery in India.
 
• Projects like AI-powered chatbots and predictive analytics tools are improving citizen engagement.
